items.q: Do I need to write SQL?
items.a: No. Dashboards, funnels and reports are built with clicks. SQL is available for teams that want it.
Most teams send their first event within an hour using the snippet or a ready connector.
Your events are stored in an isolated workspace. Export or delete them at any time from settings.

items.q: Can I share a dashboard with people outside my team?
items.a: Yes. You can share a read only live link, or send a scheduled summary by email.
